text.lead: The Nightingale (Chinese: 夜莺; pinyin: yèyīng, French: Le Promeneur d'oiseau) is a 2013 Chinese-French drama film directed by Philippe Muyl. It was selected as the Chinese entry for the Best Foreign Language Film at the 87th Academy Awards, but was not nominated.
text.cast:
- Li Baotian as Zhu Zhi Gen (Grandfather) (as Li Bao Tian)
- Li Xiaoran as Ren Quan Ying (Mother)
- Qin Hao as Zhu Chong Yi (Father)
- Yang Xinyi as Ren Xing
